regime_tldr.content: **Strongly risk-on and improving.** The Dow Jones crossed 50,000 for the first time ever on May 7, 2026. S&P 500 at 7,377 (+0.17%) and Nasdaq at 25,977 (+0.53%) — both at all-time highs intraday. US-Iran peace deal is materially advancing: Iran expected to deliver its 14-point response to the US peace proposal today (May 7), lifting risk sentiment strongly. Oil has pulled back to $94-97/bbl from $100+ peak. AMD Q1 2026 blowout (+38% YoY revenue, EPS +43%) confirms the AI capex supercycle. AI semiconductor stocks continue to lead the broad rally. Regime assessment: **strongly risk-on**, with the two remaining headwinds being Kevin Warsh Fed succession (May 15, hawkish tightening-bias tail) and final signing of the Iran MOU.
